title: Inaccurate `podman pod logs --help`
body:
### Issue Description

I expected to be able to use `podman pod logs podID` to print the logs of all containers within a pod.

Running this command returned `Error: -c or --container cannot be empty: invalid argument`.

Checking `podman pod logs --help` the first example shows `podman pod logs podID`. Either the `--help` section should be updated to make `-c` required, or it should be allowed to print the logs from all containers within a pod, I guess?

May be related to https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/26110?

### Steps to reproduce the issue

Steps to reproduce the issue

Run `podman pod logs podID`.

### Describe the results you received

`Error: -c or --container cannot be empty: invalid argument`

Only one example from the help section (the second) uses the argument `-c`.

```
Examples:
  podman pod logs podID
  podman pod logs -c ctrname podName
  podman pod logs --tail 2 mywebserver
  podman pod logs --follow=true --since 10m podID
  podman pod logs mywebserver
```



### Describe the results you expected

Either the `--help` section should be updated to make `-c` required, or it should be allowed to print the logs from all containers within a pod.
